capabilities: Toggle inline boolean values with a checkbox
Autocomplete field values from pages in a configured folder
Search autocomplete values by regexp prefix trigger
extras: README warns the plugin is incompatible with Various Complements when its "Complement automatically" setting is turned on (issue #2).
intentEvidence: aims to improve work with Dataview inline fields
problem: Obsidian's Dataview inline fields (Field:: value) are plain text with no built-in toggling or value completion while typing.

relations.evidence: improve work with Dataview inline fields (like Some Field:: value)
allows one to add sound effects when toggling checkboxes
The settings suggest input uses code from obsidian-periodic-notes

summary: Dataview inline field enhancer that adds checkbox toggling of boolean values and folder-based autocompletion of field values.
